capabilities: Display movies, TV shows, games, and books in a unified card wall with tabs
Search and add movie and TV records through TMDB
Update status, date, rating, platform, and review on media cards
Read game and book libraries from local JSON files (gamelog.json, booklog.json)
Filter and sort records by year, category, status, and platform
extras: Beta fork of MovieLog; games and books are read from JSON files intended for import or sync scripts, and onboarding sources for custom categories are not fully implemented yet.
intentEvidence: MediaLog is currently a beta fork of MovieLog.
motivation: The author extended MovieLog to cover games and books in addition to movies and TV.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to keep a unified personal record of watched, played, and read media with metadata like status, rating, and platform.

relations.evidence: MediaLog is based on MovieLog by tinazz / zzditto and keeps the original MIT license notice.

summary: Media tracker that shows movies, TV shows, anime, games, and books as a card wall stored as local Markdown and JSON files.
